verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Lord, I want to be wholehearted
God, I want to be wholehearted
Lord, I want to be wholehearted
In my love for You
In my love for You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Lord, I want to love what You love
And I want to hate what You hate
You know I want to be closer to You
Fear Your name
